name: hotspot-to-rq
description: Choose research directions or assess experiments through a mainline-controlled, context-isolated workflow.

interface.longDescription: Uses a bounded Mainline Workflow Controller to route and checkpoint project evidence mapping or existing-experiment evaluation, while isolated research roles and deterministic validators enforce evidence, debate, user gates, retries, and resumability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Mainline Workflow Controller to route this request, checkpoint every gate, and stop at the first required user decision.
